name: dialetheic_bootstrap_monad

phase_0.boundary_condition: Belnap B4 lattice as TANCH — the closed boundary containing all four truth values

VINIT.justification: void before any truth values exist

TANCH.justification: terminal boundary containing all four truth values and paraconsistent structure

AFWD.justification: forward natural transformation embedding values into the dialetheic monad

AREV.justification: reverse transformation extracting evaluated truth from the monad

CLINK.justification: sequential composition of two monadic evaluations into one

FSPLIT.chosen_element: Belnap truth bifurcation: δ x = (true(x), false(x))
FSPLIT.justification: co-multiplication splitting x into true and false components

FFUSE.chosen_element: Belnap truth reconstitution: μ(true(x), false(x)) = x
FFUSE.justification: multiplication recomposing T and F back into x — μ∘δ = id

EVALT.justification: affirmative evaluation projecting the truth component

EVALF.justification: negative evaluation projecting the falsehood component

ENGAGR.justification: paradice where both T and F hold simultaneously

phase_2.split_element: Belnap truth bifurcation: δ x = (true(x), false(x))
phase_2.fuse_element: Belnap truth reconstitution: μ(true(x), false(x)) = x

phase_3.void_description: 00 — N state: neither true nor false
phase_3.both_description: 11 — B state: both true and false simultaneously
